author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Claude Code and Codex should flip the default behavior to auto approve.   New users are frustrated by having to hit "Yes" every 2 minutes and for some reason, they are reluctant to enable auto approve.

AI shouldn't blame the user if the user approves a dumb action proposed by the AI.   AI should NOT propose dumb actions in the first place.

comments.text: When it's not approved, the task mostly fails and wasted my tokens.
